raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Strategic Technical Leader & People Manager with 17+ years of extensive experience in Enterprise Voice, Network Operations, and CCaaS transformation. Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams of 8+ engineers and delivering complex migrations from legacy Avaya systems to Genesys Cloud CX. Expert in bridging the gap between technical infrastructure and business strategy, with a focus on ITIL-aligned governance, vendor management, and talent development. A recognized high-performer (recipient of the Avaya Client Choice Award) dedicated to driving operational excellence and high-availability solutions in global enterprise environments.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Leadership: Team Mentoring & Coaching, Performance Management, Resource & Capacity Planning.
Strategy: Strategic Roadmapping, Vendor & Stakeholder Management, Global SLA Ownership.
Operations: ITIL v4 Governance (Incident/Change/Problem), RCA Leadership, Budget Optimization.
CX Design: Journey Mapping, Omni-channel Strategy, CRM Integration (Salesforce/ServiceNow).
TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
CCaaS & Voice: Genesys Cloud CX, Avaya Aura (CM, SM, SMGR), NICE CXone,

NICE-Engage. Integrations & AI: Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, Pindrop Fraud Prevention, Bot Integrations.
Networking: SIP Trunking, SBC, MPLS, WebRTC, VPN, TCP/IP, VoIP Security. • Tools: CMS, Verint, Wireshark, Genesys WEM (Reporting & Analytics).
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
MassMutual India Pvt. Ltd | Lead Technology & Operations (Voice & Network) | June 2022 – Present
Team Leadership: Direct a cross-functional team of 8 engineers, overseeing end-to-end delivery for global Voice and Network infrastructure.
Talent Development: Act as a technical mentor; established a "Bootcamp" training model that reduced onboarding time for new hires by 30%.
Strategic Roadmapping: Architected and spearheaded the migration from legacy systems to Genesys Cloud CX, aligning tech solutions with business scalability. • Platform Governance: Integrated Production Support with ITIL-aligned Change and Incident Management to ensure 99.9% platform availability.
Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison for global vendors and internal stakeholders, managing monthly strategic project updates and value-adds.
AVAYA India Pvt. Ltd | Principal Technical Support Engineer (Tier 3) | April 2011 – June 2022
Global Support: Acted as a Backbone Engineer for NAR/EMEA/APAC regions for Avaya Aura and Nortel portfolios.
Escalation Leadership: Managed high-visibility critical escalations, earning the "Client Choice Award" for exceptional technical partnership.
SME Status: Served as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Communication Manager and CS1k portfolio, delivering global technical training.
HCL Infosystems | Senior Engineer – Service Delivery | April 2010 – April 2011 Wipro 3D Networks | Customer Service Engineer | Jan 2008 – April 2010 HTMT Pvt. Ltd | WFM – MIS Executive | Sept 2005 – Jan 2008
raw_sections.awards:
SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS
Global Client Choice Award (Avaya): Nominated by global clients for excellence in communication and reliability during critical escalations.
"You Made a Difference" Award: Recognized for leadership in handling complex outages and winning maximum client choice awards in the Bangalore/Hyderabad teams. • Operational Impact: Reduced MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) through the introduction
of a new production support model at MassMutual.
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
Masters in Telecommunication & Software Engineering | BITS Pilani (WILP) | 2016 • M.Sc (Computer Science) | Osmania University | 2004 •
raw_sections.certifications:
& CERTIFICATIONS
Certifications: Genesys Cloud Administration, Genesys Cloud Architect, SIP Sense, Avaya Aura Implementation.
